mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS avatar_id, a.type , a.name AS avatar_name, a.price, CASE WHEN i.avatar_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS owned FROM avatar_tb a LEFT JOIN inventory_tb i ON a.id = i.avatar_id AND i.user_id = #{userId};

SELECT a.id AS avatar_id, a.type , a.name AS avatar_name, a.price, CASE WHEN i.avatar_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS owned FROM avatar_tb a LEFT JOIN inventory_tb i ON a.id = i.avatar_id AND i.user_id = #{userId}; where a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into inventory_tb(user_id, order_head, order_body, use_point, less_point) values(#{userId}, #{orderHead}, #{orderBody}, #{usePoint}, #{lessPoint})
